answer: Charge each new identity a fee that doubles with every identity already funded from the same source wallet, and burn the fee. The funding graph is public, so the network sees the whole tree: the first identity pays one unit, the second two, the fourth eight. A velvet rope grows heavier with each guest from the same party, and the mirror of the ledger reflects the source, not the disguise. An attacker on a knoll of fake accounts faces an exponentially rising bill no parallel trick can split, while a lone honest agent pays almost nothing.
